settings.heading: Our Team
settings.description: Meet the passionate instructors and staff who make Tropical a welcoming place to learn, dance, and connect.

settings.name: Maria Gonzalez
settings.title: Founder & Lead Instructor
settings.bio: Maria has over 15 years of experience teaching salsa and bachata across Chicago. She founded Tropical to build a vibrant Latin dance community for all skill levels.

settings.name: James Rivera
settings.title: Salsa Instructor
settings.bio: James brings energy and precision to every class. A former competitive dancer, he specializes in helping beginners find their rhythm.

settings.name: Sofia Chen
settings.title: Bachata Instructor
settings.bio: Sofia's classes blend technique with musicality. She has performed internationally and loves introducing students to the soul of bachata.

settings.name: David Kim
settings.title: Studio Manager
settings.bio: David keeps Tropical running smoothly. From class schedules to events, he ensures every student has an exceptional experience.
